note: Compose now sets TRUSTED_PROXY_COUNT from a new variable PROXY_COUNT that the server's .env lacks, so Django gets an empty string, fails on int(''), and web crash-loops after the manual docker compose up.

cause.title: fix: set the proxy count for all backend services in compose
cause.author: Philipp Klinger
cause.patch:
diff --git a/.env.example b/.env.example
@@ -14,5 +14,5 @@ ALLOWED_HOSTS=videoflix.philipp-klinger.com
 CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS=https://videoflix.philipp-klinger.com
 FRONTEND_URL=https://videoflix.philipp-klinger.com
-# Caddy is the only proxy in front of Django
-TRUSTED_PROXY_COUNT=1
+# Number of proxies in front of Django (Caddy); passed on by compose.yaml
+PROXY_COUNT=1
diff --git a/compose.yaml b/compose.yaml
@@ -13,6 +13,9 @@ x-backend: &backend
   image: ${BACKEND_IMAGE:-ghcr.io/philippklinger/videoflix-backend@sha256:346d0a94572ee913c68f3a6b528aeb79d39175beb265489ac390fdcfa72c09de}
   env_file: [.env]
+  environment:
+    # One value for web and all workers; the client IP of rate limits depends on it
+    TRUSTED_PROXY_COUNT: ${PROXY_COUNT}
   volumes:
     - media:/app/media
   cap_drop: [ALL]
